<!DOCTYPE html>

<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Larell Williams-Booker</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;1,300;1,400&family=Spectral:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;1,300;1,400&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
:root{--black:#0a0904;--gold:#c9a84c;--gold-dim:#7a6228;--white:#ede6d0;--gray:#6b6050;--border:rgba(201,168,76,0.15)}
body{background:var(--black);color:var(--white);font-family:'Spectral',serif;overflow-x:hidden}
nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:100;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:1rem 2rem;background:rgba(10,9,4,0.94);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.logo{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:1.3rem;color:var(--gold);text-decoration:none}
.nl{display:flex;gap:0.2rem;list-style:none}
.nl a{color:var(--gray);text-decoration:none;font-size:0.6rem;letter-spacing:0.18em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:0.35rem 0.6rem;transition:color 0.2s}
.nl a:hover{color:var(--gold)}
.ncta{border:1px solid var(--gold)!important;color:var(--gold)!important;padding:0.35rem 0.9rem!important}
.ncta:hover{background:var(--gold)!important;color:var(--black)!important}
.hbg{display:none;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;cursor:pointer;background:none;border:none;padding:4px}
.hbg span{display:block;width:20px;height:1.5px;background:var(--gold);transition:all 0.3s}
.hbg.open span:nth-child(1){transform:translateY(6.5px) rotate(45deg)}
.hbg.open span:nth-child(2){opacity:0}
.hbg.open span:nth-child(3){transform:translateY(-6.5px) rotate(-45deg)}
.mob{display:none;position:fixed;top:55px;left:0;right:0;background:rgba(10,9,4,0.98);padding:1.2rem 2rem 2rem;z-index:99;flex-direction:column;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.mob.open{display:flex}
.mob a{color:var(--gray);text-decoration:none;font-size:0.65rem;letter-spacing:0.18em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:0.8rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);transition:color 0.2s;cursor:pointer}
.mob a:last-child{border-bottom:none;color:var(--gold);padding-top:1rem}
@media(max-width:700px){.nl{display:none}.hbg{display:flex}}
#hero{min-height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;padding:7rem 2rem 3.5rem;max-width:860px;margin:0 auto}
.ey{font-size:0.6rem;letter-spacing:0.28em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:1.2rem;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:0 0.7rem}
.ey span{color:var(--gold-dim)}
h1{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:clamp(3.5rem,10vw,8rem);font-weight:300;line-height:0.92;letter-spacing:-0.02em;margin-bottom:1.5rem}
h1 em{font-style:italic;color:var(--gold)}
.tl{font-style:italic;font-size:clamp(0.95rem,2.2vw,1.2rem);color:rgba(237,230,208,0.55);margin-bottom:0.8rem;max-width:500px;line-height:1.6}
.sk{font-size:0.58rem;letter-spacing:0.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-dim);margin-bottom:2.2rem}
.sk strong{color:var(--gold)}
.hb{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:0.8rem;align-items:center}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:0.5rem;text-decoration:none;font-size:0.6rem;letter-spacing:0.2em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:0.9rem 1.8rem;font-family:'Spectral',serif;transition:all 0.25s;cursor:pointer;border:none}
.bg{background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--gold);color:var(--gold)}
.bg:hover{background:var(--gold);color:var(--black)}
.bd{background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--gray)}
.bd:hover{border-color:var(--gold-dim);color:var(--white)}
#stats{border-top:1px solid var(--border);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding:2.5rem 2rem}
.sg{max-width:860px;margin:0 auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}
.st{padding:0.8rem 1.2rem;border-right:1px solid var(--border)}
.st:first-child{padding-left:0}.st:last-child{border-right:none}
.sn{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:clamp(1.6rem,4vw,2.6rem);font-weight:300;color:var(--gold);display:block;line-height:1}
.sl{font-size:0.55rem;letter-spacing:0.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gray);margin-top:0.3rem;display:block}
@media(max-width:560px){.sg{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.st:nth-child(2){border-right:none}.st:nth-child(3){border-right:1px solid var(--border);padding-left:0.8rem}.st{padding:0.8rem}.st:first-child{padding-left:0.8rem}}
.sec{padding:5rem 2rem;border-top:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,0.07)}
.wrap{max-width:860px;margin:0 auto}
.lbl{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.8rem;font-size:0.58rem;letter-spacing:0.24em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:2rem}
.lbl::before{content:'';width:1.5rem;height:1px;background:var(--gold)}
.h2{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:clamp(1.8rem,4.5vw,3.2rem);font-weight:300;line-height:1.1;margin-bottom:1.5rem}
.h2 em{font-style:italic;color:var(--gold)}
.bt{color:rgba(237,230,208,0.62);font-size:0.95rem;line-height:1.8;max-width:640px}
.sw{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:0.5rem;margin-top:1.5rem}
.skl{border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--gold-dim);font-size:0.55rem;letter-spacing:0.16em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:0.4rem 0.85rem;transition:all 0.2s}
.skl:hover{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold)}
.tln{margin-top:2.5rem;padding-left:1.5rem;position:relative}
.tln::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;top:0.5rem;bottom:0;width:1px;background:var(--border)}
.tj{position:relative;margin-bottom:3rem;padding-bottom:3rem;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,0.06)}
.tj:last-child{border-bottom:none;margin-bottom:0;padding-bottom:0}
.tj::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:-1.8rem;top:0.45rem;width:8px;height:8px;border:1px solid var(--gold);background:var(--black);transform:rotate(45deg)}
.tm{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:0.6rem;align-items:center;margin-bottom:0.8rem}
.ty{font-size:0.58rem;letter-spacing:0.14em;color:var(--gold)}
.tt{border:1px solid var(--border);font-size:0.5rem;letter-spacing:0.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gray);padding:0.15rem 0.5rem}
.tr{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:clamp(1.2rem,3vw,1.7rem);font-weight:400;margin-bottom:0.2rem}
.tc{font-style:italic;color:var(--gold);font-size:0.9rem;margin-bottom:1rem}
.tp{list-style:none}
.tp li{display:flex;gap:0.8rem;color:var(--gray);font-size:0.87rem;line-height:1.65;margin-bottom:0.6rem}
.tp li::before{content:'◆';color:var(--gold-dim);font-size:0.45rem;flex-shrink:0;margin-top:0.5rem}
.tp strong{color:rgba(237,230,208,0.8);font-weight:400}
#work{padding:5rem 2rem;border-top:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,0.07);text-align:center}
.mo{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(10,9,4,0.97);z-index:200;flex-direction:column}
.mo.open{display:flex}
.mh{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:1.2rem 2rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);flex-shrink:0}
.mt{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:1.4rem;color:var(--gold)}
.mx{background:none;border:none;color:var(--gray);font-size:1.3rem;cursor:pointer;padding:0.5rem;transition:color 0.2s;line-height:1}
.mx:hover{color:var(--white)}
.mts{display:flex;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);flex-shrink:0;overflow-x:auto}
.tb{background:none;border:none;color:var(--gray);font-family:'Spectral',serif;font-size:0.6rem;letter-spacing:0.2em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:0.9rem 1.5rem;cursor:pointer;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;transition:all 0.2s;white-space:nowrap}
.tb.active{color:var(--gold);border-bottom-color:var(--gold)}
.mb{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:2rem}
.tp2{display:none}
.tp2.active{display:block}
.pl{font-size:0.55rem;letter-spacing:0.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-dim);margin-bottom:1.5rem}
.gallery{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:8px}
.gi{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:#151309;border:1px solid var(--border);cursor:pointer;aspect-ratio:1}
.gi img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;transition:transform 0.4s,filter 0.4s;filter:brightness(0.88)}
.gi:hover img{transform:scale(1.05);filter:brightness(1)}
.gi-lbl{position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;padding:0.7rem;background:linear-gradient(to top,rgba(10,9,4,0.9),transparent);font-size:0.52rem;letter-spacing:0.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-dim);opacity:0;transition:opacity 0.3s}
.gi:hover .gi-lbl{opacity:1}
.lb{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(10,9,4,0.98);z-index:300;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.lb.open{display:flex}
.lbi{max-width:88vw;max-height:82vh;object-fit:contain;border:1px solid var(--border);transition:opacity 0.2s}
.lbi.fade{opacity:0}
.lbx{position:absolute;top:1.2rem;right:1.5rem;background:none;border:none;color:var(--gold);font-size:1.3rem;cursor:pointer;z-index:10;padding:0.5rem}
.lba{position:absolute;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);background:none;border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--gold);width:42px;height:42px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;font-size:1.1rem;transition:all 0.2s;z-index:10}
.lba:hover{background:var(--gold);color:var(--black);border-color:var(--gold)}
.lbp{left:1rem}.lbn{right:1rem}
.lbc{position:absolute;bottom:1.5rem;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);font-size:0.55rem;letter-spacing:0.2em;color:var(--gold-dim);text-transform:uppercase}
.wg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:1px;background:var(--border);border:1px solid var(--border);margin-top:2.5rem}
.wc{background:var(--black);padding:2rem}
.wn{font-size:0.55rem;letter-spacing:0.15em;color:var(--gold-dim);margin-bottom:0.7rem}
.wt{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.25rem;margin-bottom:0.6rem}
.wb{font-size:0.85rem;color:var(--gray);line-height:1.7}
@media(max-width:540px){.wg{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
#contact{padding:5rem 2rem 3rem;border-top:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,0.07);text-align:center}
.cl{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:0.8rem;justify-content:center;margin-top:2rem}
.ci{margin-top:1.5rem;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0.5rem;align-items:center}
.ci a{color:var(--gold);text-decoration:none;font-size:0.6rem;letter-spacing:0.14em;transition:color 0.2s}
.ci a:hover{color:var(--white)}
footer{border-top:1px solid var(--border);padding:1.5rem 2rem;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:1rem;max-width:860px;margin:0 auto}
.fl{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-style:italic;color:var(--gold-dim);font-size:1rem;text-decoration:none}
.fc{font-size:0.55rem;letter-spacing:0.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gray)}
::-webkit-scrollbar{width:3px}::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:var(--black)}::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--gold-dim)}
.mq{overflow:hidden;padding:0.8rem 0;border-top:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,0.07);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,0.07)}
.mqt{display:flex;width:max-content;animation:mq 18s linear infinite}
@keyframes mq{from{transform:translateX(0)}to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
.mi{font-size:0.55rem;letter-spacing:0.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-dim);padding:0 1.5rem;white-space:nowrap}
.mi span{color:rgba(201,168,76,0.2);margin-right:1.5rem}
@keyframes fu{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(20px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
.fu{opacity:0;animation:fu 0.65s ease forwards}
.d1{animation-delay:0.1s}.d2{animation-delay:0.22s}.d3{animation-delay:0.34s}.d4{animation-delay:0.44s}.d5{animation-delay:0.54s}
.vgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(300px,1fr));gap:12px;margin-top:0.5rem}
.vcard{background:#151309;border:1px solid var(--border)}
.vcard iframe{width:100%;display:block;border:none;aspect-ratio:16/9}
.vcard-lbl{padding:0.6rem 0.8rem;font-size:0.52rem;letter-spacing:0.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-dim)}</style>
</head>

<nav>
  <a href="#hero" class="logo">LWB</a>
  <ul class="nl">
    <li><a href="#about">About</a></li>
    <li><a href="#experience">Experience</a></li>
    <li><a href="#work" onclick="openModal();return false;">My Work</a></li>

  <button class="hbg" id="burger"><span></span><span></span><span></span></button>
</nav>
<div class="mob" id="mMenu">
  <a href="#about" onclick="closeMenu()">About</a>
  <a href="#experience" onclick="closeMenu()">Experience</a>
  <a onclick="closeMenu();openModal()">My Work</a>
  <a href="#why" onclick="closeMenu()">Why Me</a>
  <a href="#contact" onclick="closeMenu()">Contact</a>
</div>
<section id="hero">
  <div class="ey fu d1">Entrepreneur <span>&#183;</span> Brand Builder <span>&#183;</span> Athlete</div>
  <h1 class="fu d2">Larell<br>Williams-<em>Booker</em></h1>
  <p class="tl fu d3">I don't just study business. I've already been running one since 10th grade.</p>
  <p class="sk fu d4">Seeking internships in <strong>Marketing &#183; Brand &#183; E-Commerce &#183; Operations</strong></p>
  <div class="hb fu d5">
    <button class="btn bg" onclick="openModal()">My Work</button>
    <a href="mailto:larellbooker@gmail.com" class="btn bd">Let's Talk</a>
  </div>
</section>
<section id="stats">
  <div class="sg">
    <div class="st"><span class="sn">$4,786</span><span class="sl">Revenue Generated</span></div>
    <div class="st"><span class="sn">65</span><span class="sl">Orders &#183; 30 Days</span></div>
    <div class="st"><span class="sn">3+</span><span class="sl">Ventures Built</span></div>
    <div class="st"><span class="sn">$0</span><span class="sl">Outside Capital</span></div>
  </div>
</section>
<div class="mq"><div class="mqt">
  <span class="mi">Selfmade Club <span>&#10022;</span></span><span class="mi">Brand Builder <span>&#10022;</span></span><span class="mi">Meta Ads <span>&#10022;</span></span><span class="mi">Shopify <span>&#10022;</span></span><span class="mi">Dispensary <span>&#10022;</span></span><span class="mi">Solum Wellness <span>&#10022;</span></span><span class="mi">AT&amp;T Sales <span>&#10022;</span></span><span class="mi">San Diego Mesa <span>&#10022;</span></span>
  <span class="mi">Selfmade Club <span>&#10022;</span></span><span class="mi">Brand Builder <span>&#10022;</span></span><span class="mi">Meta Ads <span>&#10022;</span></span><span class="mi">Shopify <span>&#10022;</span></span><span class="mi">Dispensary <span>&#10022;</span></span><span class="mi">Solum Wellness <span>&#10022;</span></span><span class="mi">AT&amp;T Sales <span>&#10022;</span></span><span class="mi">San Diego Mesa <span>&#10022;</span></span>
</div></div>
<section id="about" class="sec">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="lbl">About</div>
    <div class="h2">I build things that<br><em>sell themselves.</em></div>
    <p class="bt">21-year-old entrepreneur and incoming student-athlete at San Diego Mesa College studying Business Administration. Started building in 10th grade &#8212; tested, failed, leveled up. Managed dispensary operations, closed sales at AT&amp;T, and built multiple e-commerce brands generating real revenue with zero outside funding.</p>
    <div class="sw">
      <span class="skl">E-Commerce</span><span class="skl">Meta Ads</span><span class="skl">Shopify</span><span class="skl">Clothing Design</span><span class="skl">Retail Management</span><span class="skl">Sales &amp; Pitching</span><span class="skl">AI Automation</span><span class="skl">Brand Strategy</span><span class="skl">Stripe</span>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
<section id="experience" class="sec">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="lbl">Experience</div>
    <div class="h2">Real work.<br><em>Real results.</em></div>
    <div class="tln">
      <div class="tj">
        <div class="tm"><span class="ty">2021 &#8211; Present</span><span class="tt">Founder</span></div>
        <div class="tr">Founder &amp; Operator</div>
        <div class="tc">Selfmade Club &#8212; selfmadeclub.us</div>
        <ul class="tp">
          <li>Generated <strong>$4,786.17 in revenue</strong> &#8212; 65 orders in 30 days, 884% sales growth, zero outside capital</li>
          <li>Built full brand identity, Shopify store, Meta ad campaigns, and AI automation workflows independently</li>
          <li>Designed and sourced all product lines &#8212; hoodies, track pants, denim, custom pieces</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
      <div class="tj">
        <div class="tm"><span class="ty">2025 &#8211; Present</span><span class="tt">Founder</span></div>
        <div class="tr">Founder &amp; Operator</div>
        <div class="tc">Solum Premium Wellness &#8212; solumprwellness.store</div>
        <ul class="tp">
          <li>Built and manage a Shopify wellness store &#8212; product pages, checkout, conversion optimization</li>
          <li>Run all Meta ad campaigns, content creation, and day-to-day operations independently</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
      <div class="tj">
        <div class="tm"><span class="ty">2025 &#8211; 2026</span><span class="tt">Full-Time</span><span class="tt">Retail</span></div>
        <div class="tr">Manager &amp; Clothing Designer</div>
        <div class="tc">Dispensary</div>
        <ul class="tp">
          <li>Managed daily operations &#8212; staff, inventory, customer experience</li>
          <li><strong>Designed a full custom clothing line</strong> and produced all marketing creatives and ad campaigns</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
      <div class="tj">
        <div class="tm"><span class="ty">2023</span><span class="tt">Sales</span></div>
        <div class="tr">Sales Representative</div>
        <div class="tc">AT&amp;T</div>
        <ul class="tp">
          <li>Trained in consultative selling and objection handling &#8212; applied same frameworks to my own ad campaigns</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
      <div class="tj">
        <div class="tm"><span class="ty">2025 &#8211; Incoming</span><span class="tt">Education</span><span class="tt">Athletics</span></div>
        <div class="tr">Student-Athlete &#8212; Football</div>
        <div class="tc">San Diego Mesa College &#8212; Business Administration</div>
        <ul class="tp">
          <li>Entering college with real revenue data, real operations experience, and athlete-level discipline</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
<section id="work">
  <div class="wrap" style="text-align:center">
    <div class="lbl" style="justify-content:center">Selected Work</div>
    <div class="h2">Built from zero.<br><em>Proved in market.</em></div>
    <p class="bt" style="margin:1rem auto 2.5rem;text-align:center">Real products. Real shoots. Real results.</p>
    <button class="btn bg" onclick="openModal()" style="font-size:0.65rem;padding:1.1rem 2.5rem;letter-spacing:0.24em">View My Work &#8594;</button>
  </div>
</section>
<section id="why" class="sec">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="lbl">Why Me</div>
    <div class="h2">Most candidates have grades.<br><em>I have receipts.</em></div>
    <div class="wg">
      <div class="wc"><div class="wn">01 /</div><div class="wt">I've already done the job</div><p class="wb">Built brands, managed a retail floor, closed sales at AT&amp;T. Not applying to learn &#8212; applying to go further.</p></div>
      <div class="wc"><div class="wn">02 /</div><div class="wt">I learn under pressure</div><p class="wb">Lost money on ads, rebuilt smarter. Football taught me to perform when it's hard. I don't stop &#8212; I adjust.</p></div>
      <div class="wc"><div class="wn">03 /</div><div class="wt">I bring the full package</div><p class="wb">Designer. Marketer. Manager. Salesperson. Held all four at once &#8212; no team, no budget.</p></div>
      <div class="wc"><div class="wn">04 /</div><div class="wt">Athlete discipline</div><p class="wb">College football + running businesses + school. I show up every day &#8212; not just when it's easy.</p></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

  <div class="wrap">

<div class="mo" id="modal">
  <div class="mh">
    <div class="mt">My Work</div>
    <button class="mx" onclick="closeModal()">&#10005;</button>
  </div>

<div class="lb" id="lb">
  <button class="lbx" onclick="closeLightbox()">&#10005;</button>
  <button class="lba lbp" onclick="lbNav(-1)">&#8592;</button>
  <img class="lbi" id="lbi" src="" alt="">
  <button class="lba lbn" onclick="lbNav(1)">&#8594;</button>
  <div class="lbc" id="lbc"></div>
</div>
<script>

var burger = document.getElementById(‘burger’);
var mMenu = document.getElementById(‘mMenu’);
burger.addEventListener(‘click’, function() {
burger.classList.toggle(‘open’);
mMenu.classList.toggle(‘open’);
});
function closeMenu() {
burger.classList.remove(‘open’);
mMenu.classList.remove(‘open’);
}
function openModal() {
document.getElementById(‘modal’).classList.add(‘open’);
document.body.style.overflow = ‘hidden’;
}
function closeModal() {
document.getElementById(‘modal’).classList.remove(‘open’);
document.body.style.overflow = ‘’;
}
function switchTab(id, btn) {
var panels = document.querySelectorAll(’.tp2’);
for (var i = 0; i < panels.length; i++) { panels[i].classList.remove(‘active’); }
var btns = document.querySelectorAll(’.tb’);
for (var i = 0; i < btns.length; i++) { btns[i].classList.remove(‘active’); }
document.getElementById(‘tab-’ + id).classList.add(‘active’);
btn.classList.add(‘active’);
}
var curGal = ‘clothing’;
var curIdx = 0;
function getImgs(gal) {
return document.querySelectorAll(’#gal-’ + gal + ’ .gi img’);
}
function openLightbox(gal, idx) {
curGal = gal; curIdx = idx;
setLbImg();
document.getElementById(‘lb’).classList.add(‘open’);
}
function closeLightbox() {
document.getElementById(‘lb’).classList.remove(‘open’);
}
function lbNav(dir) {
var imgs = getImgs(curGal);
curIdx = (curIdx + dir + imgs.length) % imgs.length;
var el = document.getElementById(‘lbi’);
el.classList.add(‘fade’);
setTimeout(function() { setLbImg(); el.classList.remove(‘fade’); }, 180);
}
function setLbImg() {
var imgs = getImgs(curGal);
document.getElementById(‘lbi’).src = imgs[curIdx].src;
document.getElementById(‘lbi’).alt = imgs[curIdx].alt;
document.getElementById(‘lbc’).textContent = (curIdx + 1) + ’ / ’ + imgs.length;
}
document.getElementById(‘lb’).addEventListener(‘click’, function(e) {
if (e.target === this) { closeLightbox(); }
});
document.addEventListener(‘keydown’, function(e) {
if (!document.getElementById(‘lb’).classList.contains(‘open’)) { return; }
if (e.key === ‘ArrowRight’) { lbNav(1); }
if (e.key === ‘ArrowLeft’) { lbNav(-1); }
if (e.key === ‘Escape’) { closeLightbox(); }
});
var txStart = 0;
document.getElementById(‘lb’).addEventListener(‘touchstart’, function(e) { txStart = e.touches[0].clientX; }, {passive:true});
document.getElementById(‘lb’).addEventListener(‘touchend’, function(e) {
var diff = txStart - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) { lbNav(diff > 0 ? 1 : -1); }
}, {passive:true});
var io = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries) {
for (var i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) {
if (entries[i].isIntersecting) {
entries[i].target.style.opacity = ‘1’;
entries[i].target.style.transform = ‘translateY(0)’;
io.unobserve(entries[i].target);
}
}
}, {threshold:0.1});
var animated = document.querySelectorAll(’.tj, .wc, .st’);
for (var i = 0; i < animated.length; i++) {
animated[i].style.opacity = ‘0’;
animated[i].style.transform = ‘translateY(18px)’;
animated[i].style.transition = ‘opacity 0.55s ease, transform 0.55s ease’;
io.observe(animated[i]);
}

</script>
</body>
</html>
